newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR TURKEY V BELGIUM WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR TURKEY V BELGIUM WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group seven qualifier between Turkey and Belgium on Wednesday:
Turkey - 1-Rustu Recber, 2-Recep Cetin, 3-Bulent Korkmaz, 4-Tolunay Kafkas, 5-Hakan Unsal, 6-Arif Erdem, 7-Tayfun Korkut, 8-Ogun Temizkanoglu, 9-Hakan Sukur, 10-Tugay Kerimoglu, 11-Oktay Derelioglu.

Belgium - 1-Filip De Wilde, 2-Bertrand Crasson, 3-Albert De Roover, 4-Eric Van Meir, 5-Rudy Smidts, 6-Franky Van der Elst, 7-Lorenzo Staelens, 8-Luis Olivera, 9-Emile Lokonda Mpenza, 10-Vincenzo Scifo, 11-Nico Van Kerckhoven.
